regions.name: The Wardens' Lodge
regions.blurb: Rangers, gate-wardens and hearth folk of the great oaks. They keep the roads and the hunt.

regions.name: The Coven
regions.blurb: The witches' hollow: candle, cauldron and thorn, and everything stitched or brewed in it.

regions.name: The Hushwood
regions.blurb: The old deep wood and what grew up in it — fae, dryads, wyrmblood and worse.

regions.name: The Mistway
regions.blurb: River, bog and grey coast: the ferrymen, tollkeepers and drowned things of the water.

regions.name: The Hanging City
regions.blurb: The timber city on its stilts: guilds, garrison, trades and the stage.

regions.name: The Ossuary
regions.blurb: The bone lands under the old skull: the dead, the debts and the ones who collect them.

regions.name: The Frostfell
regions.blurb: The winter north: ice, raiders, the long walk and the wyrm.

regions.name: The Ironmarch
regions.blurb: Forge and powder: smiths, bombards and the coal that feeds them.

regions.name: The Far Shores
regions.blurb: A country over the sea, past every road the wood keeps. Its people come one at a time and say little of it: a spear, a masked watcher, a tongue nobody here can read.

regions.name: The Lantern Isles
regions.blurb: Shrine bells and paper lanterns, masterless swords and the curses that follow them, washed in from an older story.

regions.name: The Rooftops
regions.blurb: Uniforms, rivals and rooftops at dusk: ordinary kids from a story set after the last bell, handed powers they never asked for.

regions.name: The Neon Sprawl
regions.blurb: Chrome and rain-slick neon. Pilots, androids and a cybered oni, and the tinker who keeps them all running.

regions.name: The Starlit Court
regions.blurb: Wands, mascots and a demon lord on a throne of skulls. They brought the sparkle with them.

regions.name: The Fallen Sky
regions.blurb: Fallen out of the night sky: star-crowned, feathered, or made of glass and starlight. Of no kingdom, and welcome in none.

regions.name: The Risen Deep
regions.blurb: Risen from below, out of the black water and out of the fire under the stone.

regions.name: The Rootdark
regions.blurb: Grown in the dark and never meant to be seen: a fungus that talks, a hive and its queen, a walking hill, a marsh with a skull for a head, a moth keeping vigil.
